evidence.quote: To the north of the village are the ancient ruins of a Cucuteni-Trypillian culture settlement, dating back to the 5th Millennium to early 4th Millennium BC.

evidence.reasoning: The article dates the Cucuteni-Trypillian settlement north of Shypyntsi to the 5th millennium BC, first year -5000. Outside check: studies of the Shypyntsi A ceramics put the settlement in Trypillia stage BI (end of BI), which the standard chronology places at about 4800/4700-4400 BC, also the 5th millennium; the Ukrainian article's 'IV millennium' is a span for the Trypillia culture in the village, not a start of this settlement. No independent calibrated date for the site itself was found, so the value is the millennium start.
